title: Apple AirPods Deals: This October Prime Day Discount Gets You Apple’s Best-Selling Earbuds for Under $180
summary: Ahead of the holiday season, here's how to score AirPods Pro at a deep discount — shop online.
contentText:

With Amazon’s Prime Big Deal Days , we’re seeing a lot of deep discounts across categories, sitewide. However, one of the big standout deals is on the Apple AirPods Pro 3 .

Right now, Apple AirPods Pro 3 are on sale for $179 (reg. $249) on Amazon, a nearly 30% savings.

While the latest pair offers upgraded features like better-than-ever noise cancellation and heart rate monitoring, the older models still hold up, with great audio quality and noise-canceling technology too.

When it comes to the best Bluetooth earbuds for music, there’s no denying the popularity of the AirPods line. Apple’s famous all-white cordless earbuds are as much a status symbol as they are an essential go-to for recording artists, podcasters and music producers alike. We recommend them for everyday use as well including as an essential commuter gadget for listening to music or taking a FaceTime call while on the go.

With AirPods, you’ll get personalized spatial audio, quick access to Siri, and up to 30 hours of battery life with the charging case. They are also equipped with an H2 chip that “pushes advanced audio performance even further, resulting in smarter noise cancellation and more immersive sound,” according to the product description. The more premium AirPods Pro include four interchangeable pairs of silicone tips and feature active noise cancellation to block out all unwanted noise.

While Apple products rarely go on sale on Apple.com, Amazon has deals on AirPods and Beats by Dre earbuds and headphones with savings up to 50% off list prices .
